title: Rhode Island women's soccer adds two transfers for 2026 season - Ocean State Today
text:
Rhode Island women’s soccer head coach Megan Jessee announced on May 27 the addition of two transfers for the fall. Forward Callie Houtz from Xavier and midfielder Basie Shannon from Idaho will join the squad for the upcoming 2026 season.
Houtz joins Rhode Island after redshirting her freshman year at Xavier, where the Musketeers won the BIG EAST Championship and advanced to the second round of the NCAA Tournament. “We are really excited to be welcoming Callie to our program,” said Jessee. “She is a dynamic, pacey player who has a great willingness to win. She comes from a great environment, and we are looking forward to welcoming her shortly.”
A native of Bristow, Virginia, Houtz played four years of varsity soccer at Patriot High School. During her tenure, Patriot won a district championship in 2021 and secured two regional titles while advancing to both state championship and semifinal matches in consecutive years. Houtz also spent 14 years with Virginia Development Academy, helping win six straight Mid-Atlantic Conference championships and reaching the Elite Eight at nationals in 2023.
Shannon arrives after spending two seasons at Idaho. “We are so happy to add another to our Rhody Family,” added Jessee. “Basie adds another layer to our team. She is a dynamic aerial threat who can play both sides of the ball very well. Looking forward to seeing her thrive at Rhode Island.” Shannon appeared in one match during her sophomore season at Idaho, playing 13 minutes in a victory over UMass Lowell.
Shannon previously competed for Chicago FC United, helping capture the 2022 Girls Academy Champions Cup and served as captain of the U16 Maccabiah USA Team that earned gold at the Maccabiah World Games.
The Rams will open their 2026 campaign against Maine at home.
